label: broadcasts event
definition: Broadcaster X broadcasts or broadcast coverage of event Y.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit broadcast or telecast of Y; a stated event show on X; historical event coverage. Excludes: broadcasting another program after Y; rights ownership alone without actual coverage; advertisement placement or rejection alone; ordinary attendance or commentary about Y. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: announced future coverage or rights without realization; unclear broadcaster versus production role; generic have or show without event-coverage attachment. Separate from broadcasts_program for a named regular program; no ownership or exclusive-rights claim is implied.

facts.reason: CBS → Super Bowl: Explicit CBS broadcast and telecast of the Super Bowl establish event coverage; unrelated post-event program and rights rows are not the basis.

review.method: Explicit manual judgment after reading the full relation dictionary and every supplied case row; citations include the complete considered evidence.

facts.reason: Bush → Ariel Sharon: Political support and rebuke between people do not constitute event broadcasting.
